PACKAGING FIELDS -- archive, installers -- have no compiler counterpart and live only here.
They exist so `scripts/build-release.py` can select an archive format and installer pair by
exact triple instead of testing whether the string contains "windows", which would
misclassify any unknown triple that happened to contain it and would silently package a
target the compiler does not name.
